title: Musics/<track>.json
description: Loop points for one music track, stored beside the audio file with the same base name. Musics/Fighting.ogg is configured by Musics/Fighting.json. Optional: without it the track loops from the very beginning.

loopStartTimeInSeconds.description: Where the loop restarts from, in seconds. The Audio Editor writes this as a JSON string; a plain number works too. Values are always parsed with invariant culture, so the decimal separator is a dot regardless of the player's locale.

loopEndTimeInSeconds.description: Where the loop jumps back from, in seconds. 0 or omitted means loop at the end of the clip.

loopTimeInSeconds.description: Legacy name for loopStartTimeInSeconds, read only when loopStartTimeInSeconds is absent. Prefer the explicit start and end fields in new files.
